style.styleTitle: Personalised Robin Memorial Christmas Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: A loved one can be treasured at Christmas with this personalised memorial bauble. Add their name using up to 12 characters and a special message on the reverse. The ceramic bauble with gilt clasp is then finished with a festive red ribbon, ready to hang on the tree. Please note Robins appear when loved ones are near is fixed text.
